title: Open-immersion square
statement:
An *open-immersion square* consists of schemes $U',U,X',X$ [def-pc-scheme] and a cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]

$$
\begin{array}{ccc}
U'&\xrightarrow{g_U}&U\\
j'\downarrow&&\downarrow j\\
X'&\xrightarrow{g}&X
\end{array}
$$

in which $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ and $j':U'\hookrightarrow X'$ are open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion]. Thus $j\circ g_U=g\circ j'$, and the cartesian-square datum includes a chosen isomorphism $U'\xrightarrow{\sim}U\times_X X'$ compatible with both projections, where the fibre product is [def-pc-fibre-product]. No hypothesis on $g$ is made.
